verdict.rationale: LiteLLM ships an official proxy CLI (litellm docs-13/20/docs-4) documented at /docs/proxy/cli for configuring workers, but this is a server-management CLI for the proxy rather than an AI-native/agentic interactive CLI tool for end users to invoke models or agent workflows directly. missing for 10: evidence of an agent-facing/interactive CLI (e.g. chat REPL, agent task runner), independent hands-on validation of CLI usage, and details on CLI command coverage beyond server startup flags.
